item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 24/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will continue to bring hot weather to the coast of southern China today. A trough of low pressure will affect southern China and edge closer to the coastal areas gradually today and tomorrow. There will be more showers with squally thunderstorms over the region. Showers will be heavy in some areas. A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. Temperatures will fall slightly over the region. The easterly airstream is expected to moderate early next week. There will still be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong.
